authorization: Continue the shortest useful path toward M3: live ADC input, bounded retained evidence, and the saved autonomous-anchor result. One finite implementation and qualification; no campaign or retry.
question: Can one fixed-origin second-order residual QR sketch retain useful full-joint nonlinear likelihood behavior and support bounded anchor refinement without observation history?
finish_line: Implement and independently qualify the allocation-free C bank, execute one chronological two-arm comparison at 7200 s and 8400 s with at most two external exact-candidate audits, report fidelity, work and complete memory limitations, and choose keep/change/drop without automatically extending the experiment.

input.record: little-endian <Qddd>: sample index, actual dt_s, current_A, observed voltage_V
input.admission: Inherited source contract: finite 0<=dt_s<=1, |current_A|<=0.25 and finite observed voltage; exact source identity and contiguous indices. These are acquisition/model input limits, not residual, interval or confidence thresholds.
input.live_interpretation: Each candidate receives one ordered ADC sample once. The archive emulates a sensor for this reproducible experiment. All exact-history oracle state and replay belong only to external qualification, never the candidate or its acceptance.
input.preparation_work: Read only declared public configuration, saved accepted x and saved full Gram/charge. Fixed NumPy linear algebra, no optimizer, model, prior-function or truth evaluation. Byte-only source identity hashing is allowed and recorded separately.

representation.features: 16 PUBLIC_SD-scaled linear displacements, 20 nonzero quadratic monomials, residual constant; diagonal Taylor coefficients include one half
representation.retained_information: Square-root sum of signed second-order residual polynomials, including residual-Hessian, Jacobian-Hessian and Hessian-Hessian correlations. Full joint quartic cost; free affine control uses the same factor with quadratic monomials zero.
representation.origin_policy: Fixed forever within each arm. Estimate changes do not relinearize, translate or renew old nonlinear evidence. Carried physical derivative state stays at its original origin.
representation.history: No raw samples retained, no heap, no older posterior re-assimilation, no event replay and no noise adaptation.
representation.endpoint: SOC is exact from entering z0, logQ and total charge; RC/h states away from the origin are explicit second-order approximations. No clipping.
representation.support: Original entering parameter and state support plus exact historical SOC constraints from cumulative-charge extrema. No extra fidelity-region conditioning or truncation.
representation.failure_policy: Source/order/input prevalidation errors leave the bank unchanged. Unexpected numerical failure after in-place QR mutation latches the bank unavailable; partial evidence is never queried.

arms.name: public_origin
arms.interpretation: Public-start fixed-origin extrapolation test; no saved fitted value initializes or controls this arm.

arms.name: autonomous_origin
arms.interpretation: Retrospective bootstrap followed by local streaming maintenance. Not a causal cold-start solution.

proposal.implementation: bounded pure C using only each arm's retained sketch and the exact common supported mixture prior
proposal.metric: Full sketch Gauss-Newton plus unchanged kernel precision, symmetric PUBLIC_SD scaling, unmodified Cholesky. No eigenvalue clipping, damping sweep or metric repair.
proposal.step_cap: Uniformly shorten a solved direction so its largest PUBLIC_SD-scaled coordinate is at most one. This is a declared work/trial policy, not a coverage or fidelity bound.
proposal.acceptance: Finite, supported, numerically resolved descent of represented quartic sketch plus exact common prior, with explicit binary64 computed-operand guards. No exact-history objective is visible to the candidate or its decision.
proposal.prior: One copy of original equal-weight two-Gaussian common-support mixture in original Lebesgue dx chart. Omit common support normalizer only from objective contrasts. No separately normalized components.
proposal.ordinary_stop: No resolved direction, no accepted finite trial, or round cap means completed but unresolved. It is not exact nonlinear stationarity.
proposal.fatal_stop: Unexpected input/domain/numerical/resource/capture failure ends this attempt. Preserve partial/unknown counters and all artifacts. No retry.

external_qualification.point_order: PUBLIC_MEAN; saved a7; plus/minus one along 16 full-joint metric-whitened directions at a7; plus/minus one and two along full-joint curvature-predicted logQ and endpoint-SOC directions at a7.
external_qualification.metric: B7=saved_G7+diag(1/kernel_sd^2), scaled with PUBLIC_SD. Unmodified Cholesky. No repair, truth or new optimization. Target direction B^-1*g/sqrt(g^T*B^-1*g) retains every nuisance component.
external_qualification.node_semantics: Finite diagnostic nodes, not marginal credible intervals or profile endpoints. Unavailable/unsupported nodes remain explicitly present; no clipping, replacement, silent omission or posterior renormalization.
external_qualification.primary: 42 independent exact original-model states run alongside the two candidate banks in one archive input pass. All oracle arrays belong to external host qualification.
external_qualification.candidate_audits: After primary capture commits, at most one original-model child per checkpoint evaluates the two compactly chosen candidates, in public_origin/autonomous_origin order. Audit results never trigger acceptance, retry or additional refinement.
external_qualification.likelihood_fidelity: At both checkpoints report exact and affine/quartic costs at every available fixed node, offsets, centered errors and error oscillation. Finite-set log-odds distortion is directly interpretable; no continuous-domain bound or coverage claim.
external_qualification.candidate_fidelity: Report independently audited exact cost and endpoint at each chosen candidate beside the compact prediction. Preserve unresolved/error states.

accounting.model_step_cap_derivation: 2*294000 candidate pushes + 42*294000 fixed oracle steps + 2*252000 first audit + 2*294000 second audit = 14028000
accounting.work: Reserve each child before launch. Count attempts and completed work, mark unknown after abnormal termination; do not substitute reserved work for measured work.
accounting.capture: Use qualified capture_preservation transaction for raw stdout, streaming byte/hash identity, distinct verified copy, immutable commit and parent-pinned commit identity. Original loss remains failure even if a duplicate survives.
accounting.runtime: Cumulative parent plus waited-child CPU, active wall, exact wait4 child high-water RSS, bounded closed-output manifest, executable/source/input hashes. No other scientific process is part of this invocation.
accounting.memory: Report actual sizeof, compiler stack/call-chain evidence, static constants, phase liveness, ADC/codec reservations, caller/libm/IRQ reserves and target unknowns. One candidate replaces the old learner. Two experimental arms and all exact-reference states are host test machinery, never silently excluded from measured host RSS.
accounting.target: 10240-byte complete Cortex-M23 SRAM aspiration, no FPU, nominal 35 Hz. A host sizeof ledger with unmeasured target stack/interrupt/timing remains a proposal, not M3 qualification.

qualification_scope.capture_prerequisite: Eight already frozen fabricated real-child capture cases, no scientific work; passed receipts preserved separately.
qualification_scope.C_math: Independent finite fabricated second-order AD trajectories, QR polynomial identities, gradients/Hessians, physical support, source/chronology immutability, numerical-fault latch, no evidence duplication, exact mixture prior, bounded refinement, no-heap/layout/stack review. Separate frozen qualification contract records exact case counts.
qualification_scope.supervisor: Exactly one tiny real fabricated JSON child under its separate frozen plan; zero canonical observations/model/prior/optimizer/truth.
qualification_scope.independent_review: Review frozen plan, prepared nodes, implementation, fabricated receipts and resources before source publication and canonical launch. Review actual results and all closures afterward.

decision_rule: Report keep/change/drop for this representation based on declared finite local fidelity, public-origin extrapolation and audited compact candidate behavior, together with bytes/work. Do not tune a threshold after results, inflate intervals or announce calibrated coverage. A positive local result supports a next bounded study; a failed public-origin contrast leaves bootstrap/recentering unresolved.
M3_exclusions: no deployed ADC or checkpoint driver
warm arm is not a public-start firmware implementation
